limitations: Llama uses HTTP streaming; original engine uses subprocess commands. End-to-end transport differs.
Native reset and greedy-mode setup are outside the clock; llama request includes cache-disabled request processing.
Original layer weights also have a persistent FP32 widened prefill cache; resident memory is not equivalent.
One process is live per visit; startup and warmup excluded. Background OS work and address placement uncontrolled.
All scores require separate numerical/quality review. Discovery is exploratory, never a performance claim.

metadata.name: Combined versus tuned llama standard ten pairs

manual_evidence_review.scope: Same candidate as68-array exact/lifecycle gates and9+18 unchanged quality suites. Sampled fixed-limit oracle qualification transfers by exact bytes; no independent oracle claim for every timed position.
manual_evidence_review.comparison: Fresh direct tuned ON/ON llama cb44fdb, not chained historical ratios.
manual_evidence_review.limitations: Standard32 only; extended suite not yet published. Both decode intervals include1; not evidence of equivalence or a general winner.
